method: near-white pixels plus 32x20 meaningful-content and local-detail grids; pale panel fills and borders count as occupied for the whitespace gate; numerical screen is a triage aid, not semantic admission

records.title: BLIP-2: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training with Frozen Image Encoders and Large Language Models
records.anchor: method overview and two-stage Q-Former pretraining
records.claim: A lightweight Querying Transformer bridges a frozen image encoder and a frozen language model through two distinct pretraining stages.

records.title: InstructBLIP: Towards General-purpose Vision-Language Models with Instruction Tuning
records.anchor: instruction-aware Q-Former overview
records.claim: An instruction-aware Query Transformer selects visual evidence conditioned on the instruction before a frozen language model answers.

records.title: Visual Instruction Tuning
records.anchor: visual instruction data generation and LLaVA architecture
records.claim: Language-only GPT-4 converts image captions and boxes into visual instructions, then a projection connects a vision encoder to an LLM for instruction tuning.

records.title: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
records.anchor: Perceiver Resampler and gated cross-attention architecture
records.claim: A Perceiver Resampler compresses variable visual inputs into tokens injected through gated cross-attention layers of a frozen language model.

records.title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
records.anchor: latent diffusion architecture
records.claim: Perceptual compression moves diffusion from pixels into a lower-dimensional latent space while cross-attention injects flexible conditioning.

records.title: Adding Conditional Control to Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
records.anchor: locked backbone, trainable copy and zero convolutions
records.claim: A trainable copy of a locked diffusion encoder receives spatial controls and connects through zero convolutions without disrupting the pretrained backbone at initialization.

records.title: Scalable Diffusion Models with Transformers
records.anchor: Diffusion Transformer block variants
records.claim: A transformer processes patches of noisy latent inputs, with timestep and class conditioning modulating repeated DiT blocks before latent decoding.

records.title: DreamBooth: Fine Tuning Text-to-Image Diffusion Models for Subject-Driven Generation
records.anchor: subject binding and prior-preservation training
records.claim: A rare identifier binds a few subject images to a pretrained diffusion model while class-specific prior preservation protects diversity.

records.title: Segment Anything
records.anchor: Figure 1 task-model-data loop
records.claim: A promptable segmentation task, a modular model and an iterative data engine reinforce one another to produce transferable masks and a billion-mask dataset.
stages: image and point box mask or text prompt
data engine annotate and train loop

records.title: Masked-Attention Mask Transformer for Universal Image Segmentation
records.anchor: masked-attention decoder architecture
records.claim: Queries attend only within predicted mask regions across a multiscale pixel decoder, yielding one architecture for semantic, instance and panoptic segmentation.

records.title: Tube-Link: A Flexible Cross Tube Framework for Universal Video Segmentation
records.anchor: short-subclip tube prediction and cross-tube association
records.claim: Short subclips yield tube masks that are linked through query-level cross-tube attention and temporal contrastive features for long-video segmentation.

records.title: VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabulary Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
records.anchor: open-vocabulary video grounding overview
records.claim: Language-conditioned object queries localize referred entities across frames, then temporal modeling links detections into a spatiotemporal tube.

records.title: Mip-NeRF 360: Unbounded Anti-Aliased Neural Radiance Fields
records.anchor: contracted coordinates, proposal sampling and distortion regularization
records.claim: Scene contraction maps unbounded space into a bounded domain while proposal sampling and distortion regularization allocate detail efficiently along conical frustums.

records.title: Neuralangelo: High-Fidelity Neural Surface Reconstruction
records.anchor: multiresolution hash grid and numerical-gradient reconstruction
records.claim: Numerical gradients smooth high-order derivatives while coarse-to-fine activation of multiresolution hash grids progressively reveals high-fidelity surfaces from RGB views.

records.title: GaussianDreamer: Fast Generation from Text to 3D Gaussians by Bridging 2D and 3D Diffusion Models
records.anchor: 3D prior initialization and 2D diffusion refinement
records.claim: A text-conditioned 3D diffusion prior initializes Gaussian geometry, then 2D diffusion guidance refines appearance through differentiable Gaussian rendering.
stages: noisy point growth and color perturbation

records.title: 3DGStream: On-the-Fly Training of 3D Gaussians for Efficient Streaming of Photo-Realistic Free-Viewpoint Videos
records.anchor: neural transformation cache and adaptive Gaussian addition
records.claim: A compact neural transformation cache updates persistent 3D Gaussians frame by frame, while adaptive additions represent newly emerging content.

records.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
records.anchor: Figure 1 interleaved thought-action-observation trajectories
records.claim: Interleaving reasoning traces with environment actions lets observations update the plan and reduces hallucination compared with reasoning-only or action-only trajectories.

records.title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
records.anchor: Figure 1 comparison of IO, CoT, self-consistency and ToT
records.claim: Thought decomposition, state evaluation and search allow a language model to explore, prune and backtrack over multiple reasoning paths instead of committing left to right.

records.title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
records.anchor: self-supervised API-call insertion and filtering pipeline
records.claim: A language model samples candidate API calls, executes them and retains only calls that reduce language-model loss, producing its own tool-use training data.
stages: sample API call positions and arguments
execute calculator search translation QA or calendar

records.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
records.anchor: actor-evaluator-self-reflection episodic loop
records.claim: An actor receives scalar or textual feedback, converts failure into a verbal reflection and stores it in episodic memory to guide the next trial without weight updates.

records.title: A Time Series is Worth 64 Words: Long-term Forecasting with Transformers
records.anchor: channel-independent patch Transformer
records.claim: Each time-series channel is segmented into subseries patches, embedded as tokens and processed by shared Transformer weights while preserving channel independence.

records.title: Recipe for a General, Powerful, Scalable Graph Transformer
records.anchor: GraphGPS layer recipe
records.claim: Positional or structural encodings feed a layer that combines local message passing and global attention before a feed-forward update, retaining linear-scale variants.

records.title: Diffusion Policy: Visuomotor Policy Learning via Action Diffusion
records.anchor: Figure 1 policy representations and receding-horizon diffusion control
records.claim: A conditional action-score model iteratively denoises a multimodal action sequence from noise, then receding-horizon control executes only the leading actions and replans from new observations.

records.title: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control
records.anchor: co-fine-tuning web and robot data as token sequences
records.claim: Web-scale vision-language examples and robot trajectories are co-fine-tuned in one token interface by expressing discretized robot actions as text tokens.
